people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
translations.bsb: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
translations.kjv: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
translations.asv: From that time began Jesus to preach, and to say, Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
